# Nekko Digital

> Hawaii-based digital marketing agency — SEO, AI-search optimization (GEO/AEO), web design, and conversion strategy for hospitality, real estate, and local businesses.

This file follows the [llms.txt spec](https://llmstxt.org) and lists the canonical pages on nekkodigital.com. The companion [/llms-full.txt](https://nekkodigital.com/llms-full.txt) contains the full markdown bodies for every item.

## Services

- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://nekkodigital.com/answer-engine-optimization/): Capture featured snippets, optimize for voice search, and compete for direct-answer results across all search platforms.
- [Content Strategy & Marketing](https://nekkodigital.com/content-strategy/): Attract and convert customers with strategic content marketing — SEO-optimized blog posts, pillar content, and full editorial programs from Nekko Digital.
- [Custom Web Design](https://nekkodigital.com/web-design/): Custom responsive web design and human-centered UX/UI development focused on mobile-first performance and positive user experiences.
- [E-Commerce SEO](https://nekkodigital.com/ecommerce-seo/): Specialized SEO for online stores, improving product rankings, category page visibility, and overall e-commerce performance.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://nekkodigital.com/generative-engine-optimization/): Build E-E-A-T excellence and topical authority — the work that helps you compete to be cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.
- [Local SEO](https://nekkodigital.com/local-seo/): Hyper-local targeting, Google Business Profile optimization, and mobile-first strategies to compete for the top of local search and Google Maps.
- [National SEO](https://nekkodigital.com/national-seo/): National SEO from Hawaii, built for the AI-search era — GEO-led, editorial-grade, with same-day APAC overlap for Japan, Korea, Australia expansion.
- [Organic SEO](https://nekkodigital.com/organic-seo/): Comprehensive organic search campaigns and technical foundation audits to drive sustainable organic growth and compete for top search rankings.
- [Social Media Advertising](https://nekkodigital.com/social-media-advertising/): Data-driven social media advertising and neuromarketing campaigns that connect with audiences on a deeper psychological level.

## The Reef Method

- [Citations: AI & Search Visibility — Reef Method, Layer 3](https://nekkodigital.com/the-reef-method/citations/): The Citations layer of the Reef Method is GEO and AEO — earning recommendations from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- [Coral: Topical Authority — Reef Method, Layer 2](https://nekkodigital.com/the-reef-method/coral/): The Coral layer of the Reef Method is topical authority — pillar content, supporting clusters, and the editorial discipline to build depth in your domain.
- [Ecosystem: Compounding Authority — Reef Method, Layer 4](https://nekkodigital.com/the-reef-method/ecosystem/): The Ecosystem layer of the Reef Method — when all four layers reinforce each other and authority compounds. The long-game outcome of patient SEO + GEO.
- [Substrate: Technical Foundation — Reef Method, Layer 1](https://nekkodigital.com/the-reef-method/substrate/): The Substrate layer of the Reef Method is technical SEO — site architecture, schema, Core Web Vitals, and the foundation everything else depends on.
- [The Reef Method — 4-Layer SEO Framework | Nekko Digital](https://nekkodigital.com/the-reef-method/): The Reef Method is Nekko Digital's 4-layer framework for compounding search and AI citation authority over time: Substrate, Coral, Citations, Ecosystem.
